howToPlay: Use Scrapstorm to hit enemies and heal yourself or teammates with Mama's Hug. Place your healing turret strategically to sustain your team, and use Pulse Modulator for emergency bursts of health.
gears: Equip HEALTH to increase your survivability or SUPER TURRET to ensure your healing station stays effective. DAMAGE is also a great choice to boost your combat potential.
trait: Pam is a reliable support brawler perfect for players who prioritize team longevity and battlefield control.
